Third-party software in this directory
======================================

tsncd.<hash>.js is the production build of tsncd (https://github.com/mit-zardini-lab/tsncd) at
commit 5b5d554c52966355ad851d2209df90b26d2a1669. tsncd declares the ISC license in its
package.json; its repository has no LICENSE file or copyright line. The build bundles the
packages below, whose license texts follow: KaTeX 0.16.28, html-to-image 1.11.13, css-loader 7.1.3
and style-loader 4.0.0, all under the MIT license.

The *.html pages beside it were generated with pyncd
(https://github.com/mit-zardini-lab/pyncd) at commit 263734d63c2e3c63a2252b646429c9a2d11f3e5a;
no pyncd code is included in them. ncd-embed.js belongs to this repository.
